title: Tokio work-stealing scheduler starvation under unyielding cooperative futures
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0030: Tokio work-stealing scheduler starvation under unyielding cooperative futures
Repository: `tokio-rs/tokio`
Category: `Concurrency & Lockless Race Conditions`
Target File: `scheduler/multi_thread/worker.rs`

#### Problem Description
Worker thread local run-queue priority inversion when nested futures yield without poll_budget decrement.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Inject cooperative budget countdown and force global queue fallback check every 64 ticks.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0030.py -q`
expected_invariant: Inject cooperative budget countdown and force global queue fallback check every 64 ticks.
